finding: The COMMERCIALLY_CERTIFIED report label is a weaker audit bar than evaluateSharedCommercialEligibility (Sales Ready) and often weaker than evaluateAccountDevelopmentEligibility. Zero Sales Ready / zero Account Development is expected until product maturity fields are updated by a separate governed promotion step — certification alone must not auto-promote.
proposedCorrection: Applied: COMMERCIALLY_CERTIFIED now requires evaluateSharedCommercialEligibility Sales Ready OR evaluateAccountDevelopmentEligibility pass. CONDITIONALLY_READY remains for named+route short of engine gates. Product maturity fields are NOT auto-promoted — zero Sales Ready / zero Account Development product counts remain until a separate governed promotion write.
